title: Release pulse stabilizer: deterministic RC fingerprinting & progressive unfreeze pipeline
creator: Maya Patel
description: Stabilize the weekly release pulse by introducing a deterministic RC fingerprint and a progressive unfreeze pipeline. Goals: produce reproducible RC artifacts every cut, automate release-note seed generation, and add a staged unfreeze gate that reduces emergency hotfix churn for LTS channels. This work bundles CI changes, a small service to compute RC fingerprints, and integration with the existing release-notes automation pipeline.
tasks: RFC: define RC fingerprint algorithm and collision/rollforward semantics (finished)
Implement rc-fingerprint service (Go) with deterministic input hashing and manifest output
Add CI step to publish fingerprint to release artifacts bucket and attach to RC tag
Wire fingerprint verification into deployment gating jobs for dedicated/dedicated-preview clusters
Extend release-notes automation to accept fingerprint artifacts and seed section suggestions
Add staged unfreeze pipeline: canary -> regional -> global unfreeze jobs with automatic rollback triggers
Create dashboards/traces for RC fingerprint validation failures and gating metrics
Run two dry-run weekly cuts and post-mortem; iterate on fallout handling
acceptance_criteria: Every RC cut produces a fingerprint artifact attached to the RC tag and present in S3
Fingerprint verification job runs in CI and blocks promotion on mismatch
Release-notes generator consumes fingerprint and produces a draft changelog with >=60% of notable PRs seeded
Staged unfreeze pipeline exists as reusable workflow and supports canary/regional/global phases
Two dry-run cuts completed with metrics collected and <2 critical regressions introduced
Docs updated: runbook and oncall playbook reference the fingerprint service and rollback steps

decisions: Use a canonical JSON manifest + SHA256 of sorted entries for the fingerprint to ensure determinism
Fingerprint attached to RC tag as rc-fingerprint.json and stored in the artifacts bucket with retention 90 days
LTS cuts will require manual approval after fingerprint verification; non-LTS weekly cuts will auto-promote if gating passes
Release-notes automation will seed candidate entries flagged by the fingerprint but leave final selection to PMs via the console draft editor
postmortem_notes: Dry-run #1: missed docs-only PRs in changelog generator; root cause: PR label normalization mismatch. Fix deployed to release-notes service.
Dry-run #2: one canary region reported elevated latency due to an unrelated infra change; staged unfreeze prevented global promotion and rollback executed successfully.
Learnings: add end-to-end test that simulates RC tag creation, fingerprint upload, and gating job execution to CI matrix
